notes_for_editor: Thin: a single compiled list (tnlandforms.us) is the only tower-specific source; it gives a datasheet reference (BS0276) that the page does not explain and I did not look up. The county plan's 'New Lacy District' is a local fire district name; the plan does not mention the tower, so the story does not link them. Not on the NHLR or former-sites lists per the cached indexes. No build date, design, height, staffing, fires, status or access found. The list says names for towers 73 and above are the compiler's own creation, so 'New Lacy' may be a list name. Elevation (188) has no unit on the page. Two web searches found nothing tower-specific. Not verified on the ground. Re-checked 2026-10-21 against the live register HTML: the NHLR table (29 tower rows) and the former-sites table (2 rows) contain no New Lacy entry; the county plan's New Lacy District fire chief line was confirmed in the plan text.
